summary: Centerspace, a North Dakota REIT, agreed on September 8, 2026 to be acquired by Independence Realty Trust (IRT) in an all-stock deal. Each Centerspace common share converts into 3.8 IRT shares (exchange ratio subject to adjustment), with cash for fractional shares; Centerspace OP units receive an equal 3.8 IROP units, excluding Series D Preferred Units. Both boards unanimously approved. Structure: IRT Merger Sub merges into Centerspace, which survives as an IRT subsidiary, followed by the OP merger. Terms imply value tracking IRT's price; watch closing conditions, required IRT/CSR shareholder votes, and arbitrage spread against exchanged IRT value.
